missing.privacy.pageDescription: How Bow Down Visuals handles your data.
missing.privacy.section1Body: Bow Down Visuals operates a digital creator platform that provides AI-powered Visual Bucs for generating videos, music, images, voiceovers, lip-synced videos, lyrics, captions, thumbnails, promo clips, and related digital content. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
missing.privacy.section2Item1Body: email address and password (hashed) when you register, or basic profile information from Google if you sign in with Google
missing.privacy.section2Item2Body: handled entirely by Stripe — we never store raw card data
missing.privacy.section2Item3Body: Visual Buc usage, tool interactions, and generated content prompts
missing.privacy.section2Item4Body: info you enter to personalize AI outputs (artist name, genre, style preferences)
missing.privacy.section2Item5Body: referral codes used at signup and referral rewards earned
missing.privacy.section2Item6Body: browser type, IP address, and session data for security and performance
missing.privacy.section3Item1: To operate and improve the platform
missing.privacy.section3Item2: To process payments and manage subscriptions
missing.privacy.section3Item3: To personalize AI-generated outputs to your artist profile
missing.privacy.section3Item4: To send account-related emails (receipts, security alerts)
missing.privacy.section4Intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with:
missing.privacy.section4Item3Body: if you sign in with Google (subject to Google's privacy policy)
missing.privacy.section4Item4Body: to fulfill generation requests (prompts may be processed by third-party AI APIs)
missing.privacy.section4Item5: Law enforcement when required by applicable law
missing.privacy.section5Body: We use session cookies necessary for authentication. We do not run third-party ad trackers. Analytics, if used, are limited to aggregate usage data.
missing.privacy.section6Body: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion at any time by contacting us. Billing records are retained as required by law.
missing.privacy.section7Intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at
missing.privacy.section8Body: We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, and row-level security on our database. No system is 100% secure; use a strong unique password for your account.
missing.privacy.section9Body: We may update this policy from time to time. We'll notify you of material changes via email or an in-app notice.

missing.nfcCards.faq1a: Every card has an NTAG213 NFC chip inside. Tap it against any modern phone and your digital card opens instantly — no app needed. Older phones can scan the QR printed on the back instead.
missing.nfcCards.faq2q: Can I change my links after ordering?
missing.nfcCards.faq2a: Yes — that's the whole point. Your card points to your digital profile, which you can edit anytime: links, title, bio, photo. The physical card never goes out of date.
missing.nfcCards.faq3a: You reserve today with no charge. Once we confirm your card with our production partner, we'll collect payment and your card ships straight to you.
missing.nfcCards.faq4q: How long until I get my card?
missing.nfcCards.faq4a: Cards are made to order. Expect production plus shipping to take 2–3 weeks once payment is confirmed. We'll keep you posted at every step.
missing.nfcCards.faq5q: Can I reorder or get cards for my team?
missing.nfcCards.faq5a: Yes — order any quantity, and each card gets its own digital profile. Team packs are perfect for realtors, barbershops, salons, and agencies.
